title: DACH package holiday search
description: Search live package-holiday offers with one input across supported German operators.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Country, region, or city, for example Antalya, Türkische Riviera, Mallorca, or Hurghada.

startDate.title: Earliest departure
startDate.description: Beginning of the departure search window. Use YYYY-MM-DD or a relative value such as 8 weeks.

errorMessage.pattern: Use YYYY-MM-DD or a relative date such as 8 weeks.

endDate.title: Latest departure
endDate.description: End of the departure search window. Use YYYY-MM-DD or a relative value such as 10 weeks.

errorMessage.pattern: Use YYYY-MM-DD or a relative date such as 10 weeks.

childAges.title: Children's ages
childAges.description: Age of each child on departure. Leave empty when travelling without children.

departureAirports.title: Departure airports
departureAirports.description: Three-letter IATA codes, for example DUS, MUC, FRA. Offers that explicitly return a different airport are discarded and reported as a source-contract error.

operators.title: Operators
operators.description: Sources to query. Each successful operator or departure-airport search generates one successful-source-search event ($0.015), plus $0.002 per normalized offer row at the Free tier checked on 6 October 2026. Optional features and memory-based startup can add events. Failed searches have no successful-source-search event; live Pricing is authoritative.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: Offers returns one row per source offer. Comparisons returns one row per GIATA hotel with the cheapest offer of every source side by side, including matchQuality that declares per dimension what was matched exactly and what was normalized.

comparisonMode.title: Comparison basis
comparisonMode.description: Compare each source's cheapest offer for a hotel, or only packages with matching dates, duration, occupancy, airport, room class, and board class.

maxResultsPerOperator.title: Maximum results per operator
maxResultsPerOperator.description: Caps the number of normalized offers emitted by each selected operator.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Requests price ordering or the source's recommendation ordering.

includeRaw.title: Include raw source records
includeRaw.description: Useful for debugging but increases dataset size.

history.title: Price history
history.description: Persist deduplicated observations and optionally emit 90-day price series.

enabled.title: Enable history
enabled.description: Persist deduplicated observations in the selected store.

storeName.title: Key-value store name
storeName.description: Named store containing sharded history and derived state.

retentionDays.title: Retention days
retentionDays.description: Delete observations older than this rolling window.

observationIntervalHours.title: Deduplication interval (hours)
observationIntervalHours.description: Keep at most one observation per exact offer and time bucket.

emitSeries.title: Emit price series
emitSeries.description: Write updated series records to the default dataset.

enrichment.title: Offer detail enrichment
enrichment.description: Optionally visit a bounded number of source offer pages to fill evidence-backed baggage, transfer, and flexible-cancellation fields. Successful lookups are cached.

enabled.title: Enable enrichment
enabled.description: Visit detail pages when list responses omit useful package inclusions.

storeName.title: Enrichment cache store
storeName.description: Named key-value store used for bounded detail-response caching.

ttlHours.title: Cache lifetime (hours)
ttlHours.description: How long verified detail evidence may be reused.

maxOffersPerSource.title: Maximum enriched offers per source
maxOffersPerSource.description: Hard per-search cap on detail-page lookups.

airportMatrix.title: Departure-airport matrix
airportMatrix.description: Fan out one search per airport and emit comparable package prices by departure point.

enabled.title: Enable airport matrix
enabled.description: Run one isolated search per requested departure airport.

maxAirports.title: Maximum airports
maxAirports.description: Reject matrix inputs exceeding this number of airports.

concurrency.title: Concurrent searches
concurrency.description: Maximum parallel source searches; capped for browser memory safety.

requestBudget.title: Maximum source searches
requestBudget.description: Hard limit on operator and airport search combinations.

emitRows.title: Emit matrix records
emitRows.description: Write airport-matrix records to the default dataset.

signals.title: Capacity and price signals
signals.description: Calculate explainable availability-narrowing and price-jump signals from stored observations.

enabled.title: Enable signals
enabled.description: Calculate price and availability-narrowing signals from history.

minimumSnapshots.title: Minimum snapshots
minimumSnapshots.description: Minimum distinct time buckets required before scoring.

evidenceWindowDays.title: Evidence window (days)
evidenceWindowDays.description: Rolling observation window used to calculate signals.

emitRows.title: Emit signal records
emitRows.description: Write market-signal records to the default dataset.

forecast.title: Buy/wait forecast
forecast.description: Generate an explainable informational recommendation from price trend, volatility, departure timing, and capacity signals.

enabled.title: Enable forecast
enabled.description: Generate informational buy, wait, or neutral recommendations.

minimumObservations.title: Minimum observations
minimumObservations.description: Minimum series length required for a directional forecast.

horizonDays.title: Forecast horizon (days)
horizonDays.description: Number of future days covered by the trend estimate.

emitRows.title: Emit forecast records
emitRows.description: Write forecast records to the default dataset.

reliability.title: Reliability controls
reliability.description: Per-source circuit breaker settings for repeated failures.

circuitFailureThreshold.title: Failures before opening circuit
circuitFailureThreshold.description: Consecutive failures required to pause one source.

circuitCooldownSeconds.title: Circuit cooldown (seconds)
circuitCooldownSeconds.description: Wait time before a paused source may be tried again.

alerts.title: Webhook alerts
alerts.description: Send idempotent, cooldown-controlled price, capacity, and source-recovery notifications.

enabled.title: Enable alerts
enabled.description: Send selected events to the configured webhook targets.

webhookUrls.title: Webhook URLs
webhookUrls.description: Up to five HTTPS endpoints that receive signed JSON payloads.

priceChangePercent.title: Price-change threshold (%)
priceChangePercent.description: Minimum absolute price movement required for an alert.

capacityScore.title: Capacity-score threshold
capacityScore.description: Minimum availability-narrowing score required for an alert.

cooldownHours.title: Alert cooldown (hours)
cooldownHours.description: Suppress repeated alerts for the same subject and target.

maxAlertsPerRun.title: Maximum alert candidates per run
maxAlertsPerRun.description: Hard safety cap before multiplying candidates by webhook targets.

emitRows.title: Emit alert delivery rows
emitRows.description: Write redacted delivery outcomes to the default dataset.

alertSigningSecret.title: Alert signing secret
alertSigningSecret.description: Optional encrypted HMAC secret used to sign every webhook payload with SHA-256.

destinationOverrides.title: Advanced destination IDs
destinationOverrides.description: Optional source-specific IDs. Use only when automatic destination resolution is ambiguous.

tuiId.title: TUI destination ID
tuiId.description: Numeric TUI GIATA city or region ID.

tuiType.title: TUI destination type
tuiType.description: Whether the TUI ID represents a city or region.

dertourId.title: DERTOUR destination ID
dertourId.description: DERTOUR geo ID returned by its destination service.

wegId.title: weg.de destination ID
wegId.description: weg.de city, region, or country ID returned by its destination service.

wegType.title: weg.de destination type
wegType.description: Whether the weg.de ID represents a city, region, or country.

aiduId.title: ab-in-den-urlaub.de destination ID
aiduId.description: Destination ID returned by the ab-in-den-urlaub.de autocomplete service.

aiduType.title: ab-in-den-urlaub.de destination type
aiduType.description: Whether the destination ID represents a city, region, or country.

alltoursId.title: alltours destination ID
alltoursId.description: Node ID returned by the alltours destination tree.

alltoursType.title: alltours destination type
alltoursType.description: Whether the alltours node represents a city, region, or country.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy fallback for browser-backed searches. WEG tries direct browser access first, and direct supplier API requests never use this proxy.
